nom: Bliss Bright Idea Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum - 1 Fl Oz - Long-Lasting

avis.titre: Does NOT live up to the hype
avis.texte: I purchased this product based off an influencer video I saw on TikTok. I am 55 years old & have never had a negative reaction to a product before. I am 100% sure that this product caused my reaction, whether it be from harsh chemicals, contamination or an allergic response. Although I avoided my eye area, the skin around my eyes got swollen, red, dry & cracked. The first episode sent me to the ER because my eyes were almost swollen shut. I had gone thru 2 bottles of this product before I reacted. When I was in the ER, the doctor wanted to know if I used any new make-up or skin care. The answer was no ... so I didn't initially make the correlation. I was sent home with steriods & told not to wear any make-up or skin care until the reaction cleared up, which took several weeks. When I reintroduced make up & skin care back in, I did it one by one and just wore the basics. 4 months later, I added this Vit C serum back in & within 2 hours of application I had the same response. Buyer beware ... I looked horrible & my 2nd reaction was worse than the first. I emailed Bliss & their customer service was a huge disappointment! I even offered to send the product back so they could test to see if something was wrong with the bottle or if they wanted to test for contamination. They had no interest in getting the product back to further determine the problem. I have since discontinued using any skincare products by Bliss and my skin has improved exponentially. Don't waste your money on th

I have spent hundreds of dollars on small jars of creams, solutions, oils, and serums over time. But I keep coming back to Bliss skincare products. They work and they don't break the bank. The Vit. C Serum does brighten when used consistently for a few weeks. I notice a difference. I love the disappearing act. It amazes me how it does soften the look of skin so I see my eyes and mouth, not wrinkles, poors, and old skin. And my favorite-est is the pumpkin powerhouse. Every time I feel like my skin is rough and tired, I do this mask and it becomes so soft and feels clean but not parched the way many masks are with clay in them. Something about the pumpkin really helps. I wish they'd bring back the in the honey mask too. That was just like baby's skin in a jar! I'm in my 50's now and use it more than I did in my 20's when I first was trying to take care of my skin. I kept thinking, more money means it's better - it's not!

avis.titre: I'm getting less product in the new bottles - how??I'm getting less product in the new bottles - how??
avis.texte: I rated this 5 stars back when I first purchased it, but didn't write a review. I immediately fell in love and got another one, and have purchased it now 4 times, 2 bottles at a time. It's one of the few skincare products I've actually repurchased in my almost-35 years of caring for my own skin. This actually works. And I mean, for me, the brightening is immediate. It also softens like nothing I've ever tried. The scent isn't overpowering (maybe something mildly-but-neutrally fruity, like papaya?) and dissipates very fast. I love the texture/consistency, and it layers well under everything else I use on top, but it's hydrating enough on its own, over just toner followed by moisturizer and/or sunscreen. Now, here's where I've just had to come and write a review - and explain why it's 3 stars from me now: The packaging changed from the solid-color plastic bottles, to a frosty glass bottle in whatever color and all blue tops. We all know a pretty package mentally effects your perception of a product - it's science. So, when I ordered it for the 4th time and got the new bottle, I was not only disappointed in its look, but it looked like a smaller bottle. I mean, it is *technically* a smaller bottle, but it looked like it was holding less product. However, knowing I love the product, I obviously got past it. I think it's still the same serum, I don't have an old bottle or box to compare ingredients, but it feels/smells/looks the same. It still reads 1 oz., and it's so hard to say

avis.titre: Impressed With This Skin Soothing Serum
avis.texte: It's early days yet of using this serum, but so far, I am impressed with how it makes my skin feel. I'm a "mature woman of a certain age", and it's been a revelation as to how this Bliss serum is giving me a sense of renewed vitality to my skin. Am hoping that this rejuvenation effect will continue to improve my skin over time. The serum lotion is lightweight, and a little bit goes a long way. I use it on my whole face, avoiding the eye area, and also on my neck. There is a bit of a residue feeling, but that also supports the skin tone improvement effect. I've certainly tried other options like Retinol. This Bliss serum feels better to me than others, so I'm going to keep using it and hope for even more positive results.

avis.titre: Love the scent and consistency. Jury’s still out on effectiveness.
avis.texte: I bought this to use each night on my saggy neck skin and fine lines that are appearing around my eyes and lips. The first night, no problems, but the next night I developed an itchy rash on my neck. Now, I use it every 2-3 days. Pros: •very lightweight •consistency somewhere between a gel & a serum •lovely refreshing mandarin orange scent •cools the skin a bit immediately after application •dispenses with an easy-to-use pump •a little goes a long way •skin feels really supple about 30 minutes after application Cons: •may not be good for daily use if you have sensitive skin •no noticeable differences after a few weeks of use Not sure if I will re-order. That delicious citrus scent is absolutely lovely, though.

avis.titre: Love this product. Love the price
avis.texte: I’m 67. Have oily/combination skin. Love this product. The price is great. I went back to my $80.00/ bottle of serum and determined I couldn’t tell any difference between the two. So glad I did a comparison to know I was getting the best value! Cha Ching! And my skin looks brighter and feels “nourished”
Definitely recommend. The feeling of this is light and smooth. Makes my face so soft! And the smell is a bonus. It smells like vanilla orange cycle - it smells soooo good!!!!
my skin loves it. it very light and not greasy sinks in and my skin feels lovely, smooth and soft just bought my second one
Nice and light texture, lovely and fresh citrus smell, does not tingle skin, well absorb.

avis.titre: Nice serum but unsure about effectiveness
avis.texte: It’s a nice serum, pleasant orange smell and easily absorbed. Leaves skin soft. Not sure if it has much of an effect on my skin texture/brightness so if you have a specific skin problem I’d probably go with a higher % concentrated vitamin c. I like it but I will probably try a different product once it runs out. Also quite pricey for what it does.
Smells nice and goes on easy but sometimes my face burns after using it and I haven’t seen much of a difference in my skin (bottle is almost empty)

+ It's silky texture glides well and leave my skin plump. With consistent usage will get rid of pigmentation. It sits well under SPF. - A lot of product left at the bottom of the bottle as pump is too short to reach and the only way to get it out is to open the bottle -potentially risking contamination of product.

avis.titre: Gentle, Hydrating, and Non-Oily - Love It!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this serum. It’s hydrating without leaving me oily, which is a huge plus since so many other vitamin C serums tend to be in an oil-based formula that doesn’t work well for my skin. Most importantly, it does not irritate my sensitive skin - something I often struggle with when using active ingredients like vitamin C. I have noticed some brightening, but it’s gradual. It took about 4 to 6 weeks of consistent use to start seeing the difference, so patience is key. Just keep in mind that this isn’t a magic fix if you struggle with uneven skin tone - it’s a great addition to your routine, but make sure you’re also wearing SPF daily to protect your skin and support the brightening effects. Definitely a keeper in my routine!
These pictures are 1 year apart. You can see that the dark spot has significantly faded with use several times a week. Over that time I used almost 1 bottle. Will definitely purchase again.

avis.titre: Product okay, bottles now seriously unattractive
avis.texte: I'm very annoyed that they changed the packaging. The vit c was orange and the hyaluronic turquoise, etc. Now they have hybridized the colors. Aesthetics are important. Now the bottles confusing and much less pleasant to look at on the shelf. The look was a major attraction that has now been ruined. I'd be more okay with the new look if it improved being able to get all of the product out of the bottle. Even leaving the bottle upside down for several days does not allow you to use all of the product. I believe that one ounce at a time is crazy. It is nearly impossible to get the final 10 or 15% out of the bottle. I think it is being okay for my skin, but I believe I will go back to Paula's choice - their packaging has been unattractive all along.

This Bliss Vitamin C + Tri-Peptide Bright Idea Serum – 15% Brightening + Barrier Boost Complex for Radiant, Firm Skin – Anti-Aging Face Serum Boosts Collagen & Elasticity - 1 fl oz is a VERY nice serum. Ive used it twice daily for the last 3 days and it quickly soaks in and feels wonderful on my skin. I will continue using it when this bottle is empty. Nice product for sure.

avis.titre: Holy Allergic Reaction… Eczema Peeps Proceed With Caution
avis.texte: YIKES…. Not sure where to start. So I have pretty sensitive skin, I do have eczema and I have had peri-oral dermatitis in the past but I HAVE used this brand of vitamin C serum before. I chose to go with a vitamin c and peptide brightener because I am a breastfeeding momma so I have to avoid retinols, retinoids, AHAs, BHAs, etc. BOY DO I WISH I WOULD HAVE SKIPPED THIS ONE. Upon application, my skin was seemingly adjusting ok. Hours went by, I started to feel a stinging sensation. I washed my face a moisturized with my normal products. That night, I had very red, tight, burning skin and I also felt maybe light swelling. The next day was the same of rough, red, burning skin and the swelling continued, almost as if I had chemical burns. 2 days after initial application, I woke up to have my eyes almost swollen shut. A fast trip to Urgent Care, a steroid shot and meds later, and I was finally recognizable again. Basically, if you have sensitive skin, eczema, etc I don’t think this is the product for you. I think the reformulation is just too strong for skin with sensitive/compromised barrier. As for the price, not bad for a chemical burn/exfoliant lol I had to go through a lot of pain but I basically have new skin 😂 no but really, proceed with caution on this one if you are super sensitive. Everyone is different but Patch test FOR SURE! I wish I had!!!

Pleasant smell and not greasy. I don't notice anything different with my skin but I always use vitamin c serum. A little sticky at first but goes away after it dries. I have sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate me.

The first time I tried this, it was given to me. It was so good that I had to buy it again. It made such a difference in my skin. Definitely see a huge improvement in dark spots and hyper pigmentation I would recommend this product to any type of skin oil or dry I love using this before putting on my makeup. I also follow up with a moisturizer after putting on the serum.

I already have pretty good skin so I can't really say if this is especially good. But I like that it's not super thick and it doesn't feel heavy on my skin. It's a good moisturizer though and my skin still looks good with it so it hasn't caused any issues for me.

Skincare was off limits for going plastic free(as much as possible) but this bottle is out of control. I will not be buying this anymore.
I would give zero stars if I could. Horrible overnight reaction to something in this. Had to go to urgent care on day #2, as the pain and swelling got worse. Do not purchase!!

This broke my skin out terribly. I had to get on oral steroids and creams from use of this product. The product worked fine for me up until my last purchase. I purchased a total of 3 times. I’m not sure if they changed the formula or I got a bad batch but I had a terrible skin reaction and will not be purchasing again. Make sure you try this as soon as you get it. The first bottle I bought was fantastic. It went on so soft and silky. No problems. My skin felt dewy and hydrated. I use it very sparingly so I just opened the bottle I purchased a few months ago. This one stings my face like a sunburn. This is how I woke up this morning. I wonder how many others have had this happen.
Been wanting to try this serum and glad I purchased it. Good moisturizer and makes my skin soft.

I very rarely leave reviews, but I sincerely think this product should be removed from the market. I developed some sort of dermatitis/allergic reaction to this product. It turned my whole face red and dry and like burnt feeling, my eyes and lips became swollen, and I had almost chemical like burns…really crispy, almost sore, like spots by my eyes and by my lips ( no I did not apply this product to my lips or my eyes). 100% do not buy.

I missed a week of work and had to pay $75 for the urgent care.How dare you say that it brighten skin and boost collagen for a glowing youthful look when I look like a monster and my skin was on fire and it was burning And I couldn’t see out of my eyes.

I waited a week and tried it again to be sure it was this product and it happened again. I've never had a reaction to a skincare product, so I'd beware of this one!

By process of elimination, I have determined that something in this product makes my face and neck break out in hives. I love the smell and freshness of it but I am 100% certain there is something in it that causes a very painful skin irritation and eye swelling.

I used two bottles of this without any issues. After several months of use my face broke out in a terrible, painful rash. I do not have sensitive skin and I have never had a reaction to any product ever before. It was so painful that it brought me to tears. Even though I didn’t use this on my eyelids, I had cracked, tight, dry, painful sores on my eyelids and around my mouth. It got so bad that I eventually had to go see a dermatologist and be put on an oral steroid as well as a steroid cream. My dermatologist asked if I had started using any new products. I said no because I’ve been using the same products for many months. Regardless, I was advised to discontinue all of my skin care routine for 30 days and re-introduce each product one at a time to try to figure out what caused the reaction. After 10 weeks I decided last night to reintroduce this serum. I woke up this morning with a horrible reaction on my face. It is definitely this product that has caused my painful sores. Do not use! Sadly, I still have a couple full bottles on my shelf that are unopened, but they will be going directly in the trash. I wish I could give this zero stars.

avis.titre: Best Vitamin C product I’ve used so far!
avis.texte: I have ordered several different brands of vitamin C serum through Amazon, but I find this one to give me the best results in terms of even skin tone, brightness, and how supple it leaves my skin. And I am prone to sensitive skin, and have had no issues with that. I was a little disappointed that they no longer had it available on subscribe and save, but you can still get the one time purchase option. 👍🏻👍🏻

avis.titre: Allergic Reaction - Do a spot test!!
avis.texte: Please, PLEASE do a test spot with this stuff before you put it all over your face. I know plenty of people seem to not have a reaction, but as you can see, I had a bad time with this serum. I used it 2-3 times and within that time frame, my face broke out in these bumps that progressively got worse. I've stopped using it of course, but now my skin will probably take a while to heal. I've used different vitamin C products in the past and never had this happen, so I think it's something else that my skin doesn't like. Just be careful, and keep an eye on your skin if this is a new product for you.
